description: Read Snapchat ad performance — impressions, spend, swipes and video quartiles — at ad account, campaign, ad squad or ad level. THREE THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE CALLING: granularity is required (TOTAL is the default); DAY and HOUR granularity REQUIRE startTime and endTime AND both must land exactly on the start of an hour, which Snapchat refuses otherwise and Hermoso refuses for free before spending the call; and SPEND COMES BACK IN MICRO-CURRENCY, so divide by 1,000,000 before quoting money to anyone. It changes nothing on the ad account; with async:true it starts a report file on Snapchat that is kept for seven days. Free.

actionReportTime.description: count a conversion on the day it happened (conversion, default) or on the day of the ad impression (impression)

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account id shared with this profile; omit when only one is shared

async.description: for long ranges or wide breakdowns: starts a report run on Snapchat that builds a downloadable CSV/Excel file (kept seven days) and returns its reportRunId

asyncFormat.description: csv or excel; file format for an async:true report

breakdown.description: object-level breakdown: ad, adsquad (campaign stats only) or campaign (ad-account stats only)

conversionSourceTypes.description: comma-separated: web, app, offline, total, total_off_platform, total_on_platform — splits conversions by where they happened

endTime.description: ISO 8601, on the start of an hour

granularity.description: default TOTAL. DAY and HOUR need startTime and endTime, both on the hour.

id.description: the object to report on — defaults to the ad account itself for level:adaccount

omitEmpty.description: drop days/entities with zero on every metric

reportDimension.description: break the numbers down by AUDIENCE — age, gender, age,gender, country, region, dma, os, device make or interest (lifestyle_category). Not with HOUR. region / dma / make / lifestyle_category / the os+country pairs carry DELIVERY metrics only (no conversion_* fields)

reportRunId.description: fetch an async report started earlier — same level and id

startTime.description: ISO 8601, on the start of an hour (22:00, never 22:45)

swipeUpAttributionWindow.description: how long after a SWIPE a conversion still counts in this report. Omit to use the ad account default. It only changes how this report counts conversions; the ad account itself is not changed.

viewAttributionWindow.description: how long after a VIEW (no swipe) a conversion still counts; 'none' attributes no view-throughs at all. Omit to use the ad account default.

name: snapchat_ads_report
title: Snapchat ad performance
